\begin{example} \end{example}[Coordinate Vector Fields]

1. ch8:8.2For a smooth chart $(U,(x^i))$ on $M$, the assignment \[ p\longmapsto \left.\frac{\partial }{\partial x^i}\right|_p \] is a smooth vector field on $U$, called the $i$th coordinate vector field. Its components in this chart are constant. \end{example}
